description: The bar chart illustrates token counts (in thousands) across several text categories for a Sámi-language dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categories labeled “Administrative,” “Religion,” “Non-fiction,” “Fiction,” “Law,” “News,” and “Blogs,” shown in that left-to-right order with diagonally rotated tick labels, and the axis label reads “Categories.” The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Tokens (K),” using a linear scale from 0 up to a little above 10,000, with regularly spaced tick marks at 2,000-unit intervals. Each category is represented by a single light-blue vertical bar with a dark-blue numeric annotation above it: Administrative is approximately 6,472K, Religion 652K, Non-fiction 1,889K, Fiction 387K, Law 354K, News 10,584K, and Blogs 32K. There is no legend, no stacking or grouping beyond one bar per category, and the bars do not appear to be sorted by value; no bars are specially outlined or otherwise emphasized beyond the value labels.
